# Getting help

- **Something doesn't work?** Open a [bug report](https://github.com/nielsbrakel/WidgetBox/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- **Missing a widget or setting?** Open a [feature request](https://github.com/nielsbrakel/WidgetBox/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- **Found a security problem?** Follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md). Don't open a public issue.
- **Want to contribute?** Start with [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

WidgetBox is maintained in spare time, so answers can take a few days.
